args.title: Make error toasts assertive and persistent
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Change the toast container's aria-live attribute to 'assertive' for error toasts so they are announced immediately by screen readers. Also, prevent error toasts from auto-dismissing after five seconds so they stay until dismissed, supporting accessibility.

file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Error toasts should use an assertive live region instead of polite for immediate announcement by screen readers. They should also not auto-dismiss after five seconds but remain until dismissed to ensure users see them. Both changes are in src/components/Toast.tsx, the file managing the toast UI and behavior.
